description: Branch R-FMT-2 Generated values, random AutoNumber by DAO, repairing the first attempt (the NewValues property was appended to a field of an existing table, accepted, and the IDs stayed sequential). On an ACCDB: (1) the Properties of an ordinary AutoNumber field are listed (is NewValues a built-in property, and its value?); its NewValues value is put to "Random" and to 1 with a marked Errors read, then three rows inserted and the IDs read; (2) a table made through CreateTableDef whose ID field has Attributes 16 (dbAutoIncrField) and a NewValues property created as Text "Random" and appended to the new field's Properties before the field is appended; (3) the same with the property created as Long 1; (4) the same without any NewValues property (the control). Each table gets six inserts without an ID; the IDs are read. Asks whether DAO can produce a random AutoNumber at all and by which route.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
